answer: Escrowed reputation annuity: each identity's fee rebate accrues only while its record stays unmerged, so a zephyr of fresh clones forfeits that stream. Merging detected duplicates into one ledger entry—flagged when a basalt-hard proof-of-work nonce collides across accounts—zeroes accrued rebates for every linked clone. An attacker must fund each clone's work and abandon its annuity, making a karst of cheap aliases costlier than one honest tenure.
